mutations.name: a 0 on top alone is sorted as 0/0
the rule divides the slopes upside down
the rule is used whatever the ratio
the slope of sin 2x drops its 2
mutations.find: dtop:'2 cos 2x', dbot:'1', f:x=>Math.sin(2*x), g:x=>x, fp:x=>2*Math.cos(2*x), gp:x=>1},
mutations.replace: dtop:'cos 2x', dbot:'1', f:x=>Math.sin(2*x), g:x=>x, fp:x=>Math.cos(2*x), gp:x=>1},

mutations.name: a 0/0 with a 0 limit is not told
mutations.find: zeros(){ return [0,1,2,3].filter(i=>{ const S=this.R()[i]; return this.zz(S) && Math.abs(this.rule(S))<1e-12; }); },
mutations.replace: zeros(){ return [0,1,2,3].filter(i=>{ const S=this.R()[i]; return this.zz(S) && Math.abs(this.rule(S))<1e-12 && S.a>0; }); },

mutations.name: a log that plugs in is told as hiding a 0
mutations.find: logs(){ return [0,1,2,3].filter(i=>{ const S=this.R()[i]; return this.zz(S) && !!S.ln; }); },
